hints.title: Per-Trade Fee Deduction Obstacle
hints.text: Every completed stock transaction incurs a fixed fee. How can updating the maximum profit when holding a share versus not holding a share incorporate the fee into trade transitions?

hints.title: Dual Holding State Invariant
hints.text: Holding profit is max(holding profit, cash profit - price). Cash profit is max(cash profit, holding profit + price - fee).

hints.title: Two Scalar Register Transition Procedure
hints.text: Initialize hold to -prices[0] and cash to 0. Iterate through remaining prices: update cash to max(cash, hold + price - fee) and update hold to max(hold, cash - price). Return cash.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of days in prices
complexity.notes: Single pass updates two scalar registers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching across all buy/sell points takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant scalar registers avoid table allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deducting the fee once per round-trip trade (e.g. at sale time).
